Definition: from G1364 and G3056; equivocal, i.e. telling a different story:--double-tongued.
BiblicalUsage: Double-tongued, saying one thing to one person and another to another, the opposite of the plain speech a deacon must have.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a double tongue disqualifies a servant of the church, because God's people must be able to trust what I say in every room.
